preToolUse.powershell: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $runtimeFile = Join-Path (Get-Location) '.tools/node-path.txt'; $guardRuntime = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runtimeFile -PathType Leaf) { [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($runtimeFile).Trim() } else { (Get-Command node -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop).Source }; if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($guardRuntime) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $guardRuntime -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Invalid local Node.js runtime configuration.' }; [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | & $guardRuntime './scripts/guard.js'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
